## Security checklist

This repository is vulnerable by design, which makes a few things easy to get
wrong. Please confirm each of these:

- [ ] **No flag values committed.** Flags are per-deployment secrets generated by
      `make setup`. No `YGGDRASIL{...}` literal in application source, SQL seed,
      Dockerfile, or documentation — including as an `||` fallback. Synthetic
      values in `tests/` are fine.
- [ ] **No credentials, tokens or keys committed**, and `make test-security` passes.
- [ ] If this touches the **control plane** (`gatekeeper/`, `flag-oracle/`), it is
      written as production code to ASVS Level 2 — not as challenge content.
- [ ] If this touches a **realm**, any new weakness is intentional, documented in
      that realm's `manifest.json`, and marked in code with a `// VULNERABLE:` comment.
- [ ] If this changes realm dependencies, the change is deliberate — Dependabot
      is deliberately not pointed at `realms/`, because bumping a pinned
      vulnerable version silently repairs the challenge.

## Checklist

- [ ] Commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] Documentation updated where behaviour changed
